verdict.rationale: uv supports exact version pinning at multiple levels: `uv.lock` provides a cross-platform lockfile with exact dependency versions that is respected on `uv run`/`uv sync`, `uv python pin` pins the exact Python version per project via `.python-version`, and `uv add`/`uv remove`/`--upgrade-package` let developers control exact package versions while the rest of the lockfile stays intact. Tool version pins are also respected via `uvx [email protected]` and `uv tool upgrade` constraints. missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation that lockfile pins are strictly enforced across CI/collaborators beyond docs, and community notes on pre-release version resolution quirks (uv-comm-9) suggest minor edge-case friction.
